stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is Yondu's first mate, and the Ravagers team up with the Guardians against Ronan. When Drax calls the Sakaarans paper people, Kraglin likes it so much he punches him on the shoulder.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Yondu's first mate, who fights beside Drax and the Guardians against Ronan.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian whose paper people line Kraglin loves.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Kraglin is now a member of the Guardians, and he flies with Drax and the team on their missions across the galaxy.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian now, flying with Drax on the team's missions.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian on the team that welcomes Kraglin.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: When the High Evolutionary takes Drax captive aboard Arête, Kraglin flies Knowhere in and blasts a way into the ship for the rescue.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who flies Knowhere in to rescue Drax.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Kraglin flies Knowhere in to rescue.

their_evidence: Quill tells Kraglin they need his help to save Nebula, Drax and Mantis from the High Evolutionary, and Kraglin pilots Knowhere to Arête and blasts a hole in it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Gamora and Groot first meet brawling over the Orb on Xandar, escape the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. Groot gives his life to shield the team when the Dark Aster crashes.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, who gives his life to shield the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, first met brawling over the Orb on Xandar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gamora looks out for the young Groot in battle, warning him out of harm's way during the fight with the Abilisk.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, whom Gamora looks out for as a youngster.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, who looks out for Groot in battle.

question: This Gamora is the 2014 variant, who does not know Groot as a friend and returns to the Ravagers. Should her Vol. 3 stage with Groot be ally (proposed) or stay friend like the earlier stages with the original Gamora?

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill is Nick Fury's right hand at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his most trusted friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's boss and one of her most trusted friends at S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his most trusted friends.

stages.title: Secret Invasion#1
stages.text: Hill joins Fury when he comes back to Earth to stop the rogue Skrulls. In Moscow she is shot dead by Gravik, who is wearing Fury's face.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's old boss and friend. She joins his fight against the Skrulls and dies.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand. Gravik shoots her dead in Moscow while wearing his face.

proposed.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
proposed.text: After Fury fakes his death, Hill keeps him hidden at a safehouse and brings Steve, Natasha and Sam to him. When they move against HYDRA, she takes control of the helicarriers so they destroy each other.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The boss Hill hides after his faked death.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hides Fury after his faked death and turns the helicarriers on each other.

their_evidence: Fury is ambushed on his way to meet Hill; Hill extracts Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson to the safehouse where Fury, who faked his death, plans the chip swap; Rogers replaces the last chip, allowing Hill to take control and have the vessels destroy each other.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Dr. List runs Hydra's Scepter experiments in Sokovia that give Pietro and Wanda their powers. When the Avengers attack, List urges Strucker to send the twins against them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A volunteer List exposes to the Scepter. Gains powers from it.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist whose Scepter experiments give Pietro powers.

proposed.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
proposed.text: In a HYDRA lab, Dr. List and Strucker keep Pietro as one of two surviving test subjects of their scepter experiments, and List asks what is to be done with the twins.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A test subject List keeps in his HYDRA lab.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist who keeps Pietro as a test subject.

their_evidence: Mid-credits scene: List and Strucker discuss the twin test subjects given superhuman abilities, shown held in the lab; List asks what to do with the twins.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Dr. List runs Hydra's Scepter experiments in Sokovia, which kill the other volunteers but give Wanda and Pietro their powers. When the Avengers attack, List urges Strucker to send the twins against them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A volunteer List exposes to the Scepter, giving her powers.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist whose experiments give Wanda powers.

proposed.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
proposed.text: In a HYDRA lab, Dr. List and Strucker keep Wanda as one of two surviving test subjects of their scepter experiments, and List asks what is to be done with the twins.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A test subject List keeps in his HYDRA lab.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist who keeps Wanda as a test subject.

their_evidence: Mid-credits scene: List and Strucker discuss the twin test subjects given superhuman abilities, shown held in the lab; List asks what to do with the twins.

question: The twins appear only as held test subjects in the mid-credits scene, with no exchange of words with List. Keep the proposed earlier boss stages for List here, or leave the ties starting in Avengers: Age of Ultron?

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: The Winter Soldier shot Natasha Romanoff years ago while killing her target, and he comes after her again when HYDRA rises in Washington.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Shot by Bucky years ago. HYDRA sends him after her again in Washington.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Winter Soldier, who shot Natasha years ago and comes after her again.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff and Bucky Barnes end up on the same side in Wakanda, fighting off Thanos' army.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Once shot by Bucky. On the same side against Thanos' army in Wakanda.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Winter Soldier who once shot Natasha. An ally in Wakanda.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: In Berlin, the triggered Bucky strangles Natasha until T'Challa pulls him off. At the Leipzig airport she stops T'Challa with her stingers so Bucky and Steve can escape in the Quinjet.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Strangled by Bucky in Berlin, then lets him and Steve escape at the airport.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Winter Soldier, who strangles Natasha in Berlin and whom she lets escape.

their_evidence: Berlin JCTC: the triggered Winter Soldier strangles Romanoff until T'Challa intervenes; at Leipzig-Halle she tasers Black Panther so Rogers and Barnes reach the Quinjet.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton are best friends. He was sent to kill her years ago but recruited her into S.H.I.E.L.D. instead.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's best friend. Sent to kill her, he recruited her into S.H.I.E.L.D. instead.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Natasha's best friend, who was sent to kill her but recruited her instead.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: On Vormir, Natasha and Clint fight over which of them will be the sacrifice for the Soul Stone, and she gives her life so he can live.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's best friend, who gives her life on Vormir so he can live.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Natasha's best friend, for whom she gives her life on Vormir.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: Clint and Natasha fight on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport. Mid-fight she asks if they are still friends, and he jokes that it depends on how hard she hits him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's best friend, fought on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Natasha's best friend, who fights her at the airport but jokes they're still friends.

their_evidence: Leipzig-Halle Airport battle: Black Widow and Hawkeye fight; she asks if they're still friends, he says it depends how hard she hits him.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark brings in F.R.I.D.A.Y. to replace J.A.R.V.I.S. after Ultron's attack. She runs his suits and labs and becomes the voice at his side in every fight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, who brings her in to replace J.A.R.V.I.S.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I. after J.A.R.V.I.S., running his suits and labs.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs the simulation that cracks time travel for Tony. After he uses the Stones to beat Thanos, she reports to Pepper that his life functions are critical as he dies.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, whose dying moments she reports after the Battle of Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who helps him crack time travel and reports him dying.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs Tony's armor through the airport battle and finds that the fake psychiatrist is Zemo. In Siberia, Tony has her analyze Steve's fight pattern so he can counter his blows.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, who has her identify Zemo and read Steve's fighting.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who uncovers Zemo and scans Steve's fight pattern in Siberia.

their_evidence: F.R.I.D.A.Y. assists at Leipzig-Halle, reads Rhodes's vitals, identifies Broussard's killer as Helmut Zemo, and in Siberia analyzes Captain America's fight pattern on Tony's order.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: When Vanko takes over Rhodes's War Machine armor at the Stark Expo, Natasha, undercover at Stark Industries, breaks into Hammer's system and gives him back control.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Undercover S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who gives Rhodes back control of his armor.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: War Machine, whose armor Natasha frees from Vanko's control.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: James Rhodes and Natasha Romanoff fight side by side against Ultron in Sokovia, and both join the new Avengers.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger who fights beside Rhodes in Sokovia.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who fights beside Natasha in Sokovia.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Rhodey and Natasha are among the few Avengers left, and they keep working side by side from the Avengers compound.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend and one of the few Avengers still standing after the Snap.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend and one of the few Avengers still standing after the Snap.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: Rhodes and Natasha both sign the Sokovia Accords and fight on Tony's side at the Leipzig airport, where Rhodes is shot down.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow signer of the Accords, on Tony's side at the airport.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow signer of the Accords, shot down on Tony's side at the airport.

their_evidence: Romanoff tells Rogers that Stark, Rhodes and Vision have signed; both are on Stark's team at Leipzig-Halle, where Rhodes crashes after Vision's misfire.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Natasha and Sam fight alongside Steve Rogers to expose Hydra and stop Project Insight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who fights beside Natasha to stop Project Insight.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who fights beside Sam to expose Hydra.

stages.text: After the Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, they spend two years on the run together with Steve.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend and fellow fugitive on the run with Steve.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend and fellow fugitive on the run with Steve.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: When Natasha backs the Sokovia Accords, Sam asks if she is the same woman who once told the government off. They end up on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who questions Natasha's support for the Accords.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who backs the Accords while Sam refuses them.

their_evidence: Accords debate at the Avengers Compound: Sam asks Natasha if she is the same woman who told the government to kiss her ass; Sam joins Rogers's team, Natasha Stark's, at Leipzig-Halle.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Steve Rogers and Natasha Romanoff first fight side by side in the Battle of New York.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's teammate in the Battle of New York.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate in the Battle of New York.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: They go on the run together when Hydra takes over S.H.I.E.L.D., and they become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Natasha goes on the run with when Hydra takes over.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend Steve goes on the run with when Hydra takes over.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Steve and Natasha hold the remaining Avengers together for five years, until Natasha gives her life on Vormir.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's close friend, holding the Avengers together with her after the Snap.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's close friend, who gives her life on Vormir.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: Natasha signs the Sokovia Accords and comes to Peggy's funeral so Steve is not alone. At the Leipzig airport she lets him and Bucky escape rather than fight him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Natasha comforts at Peggy's funeral and lets escape at the airport.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who comforts Steve at Peggy's funeral and lets him escape.

their_evidence: Romanoff finds Rogers after Peggy Carter's funeral ('I didn't want you to be alone'); at Leipzig-Halle she lets Rogers and Barnes go and holds off Black Panther.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff goes undercover as Natalie Rushman, Tony Stark's assistant, to assess him for S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's assignment, whom she assesses undercover as his assistant.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's assistant, Natalie Rushman, secretly assessing him for S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Tony and Natasha fight side by side as Avengers in the Battle of New York and become teammates for years.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger and longtime teammate.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger and longtime teammate.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap they reunite for the time heist, and both give their lives to defeat Thanos.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger who, like Natasha, gives his life to defeat Thanos.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who, like Tony, gives her life to defeat Thanos.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: Natasha sides with Tony on the Sokovia Accords and fights on his team at the Leipzig airport. After she lets Steve and Bucky go, they argue and he warns her that Ross is coming for her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Natasha backs on the Accords, then crosses at the airport.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who backs Tony on the Accords, then lets Steve go.

their_evidence: Romanoff agrees with Stark on the Accords and joins his team; after the airport battle they argue and Stark tells her T'Challa told Ross what she did, so they're coming for her. Romanoff goes into exile.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Natasha and Steve Rogers train Vision as part of the new Avengers after Sokovia.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A new Avenger Natasha helps train after Sokovia.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of the Avengers who train Vision after Sokovia.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Thanos's forces come for the Mind Stone, Natasha fights to protect Vision in Edinburgh and Wakanda.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Natasha fights to protect from Thanos's forces.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who fights to protect Vision from Thanos's forces.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: Natasha and Vision both sign the Sokovia Accords and fight on Tony's side at the Leipzig airport.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow signer of the Accords, on Tony's side at the airport.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow signer of the Accords, on Tony's side at the airport.

their_evidence: Both take part in the Accords debate at the compound; Romanoff tells Rogers Vision has signed; both are on Stark's team at Leipzig-Halle.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson and Steve Rogers meet while running in Washington and quickly become close friends, and Sam joins his fight against Hydra.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's close friend, met running in Washington.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's close friend, met running in Washington. Joins the fight against Hydra.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the final battle, an aged Steve hands Sam his shield and asks him to carry it on.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's friend. Hands Sam the shield and asks him to carry it on.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's friend. Steve hands him the shield and asks him to carry it on.

proposed.title: Captain America: Civil War
proposed.text: Sam refuses the Sokovia Accords and stands with Steve, helping him protect Bucky and fighting at his side at the Leipzig airport. Sam is locked in the Raft, and Steve breaks him out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's friend, who breaks him out of the Raft.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's friend, who sides with him against the Accords.

their_evidence: Rogers and Wilson track Barnes to Bucharest, go rogue, fight at Leipzig-Halle; Wilson is detained at the Raft and Rogers breaks his allies out.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Darcy Lewis is Jane Foster's intern and becomes one of her closest friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Darcy's boss and one of her closest friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jane's intern and one of her closest friends.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Darcy stands by Jane through her stage four cancer, going with her to chemotherapy and urging her not to face it alone.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend Darcy stands by through stage four cancer.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who goes with Jane to chemotherapy and urges her not to face cancer alone.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Darcy interrupts Jane's date to bring her to the London factory where strange readings have appeared, and later stands with her at Greenwich using Selvig's devices against the Dark Elves.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jane, pulled from a date by Darcy to chase strange readings.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who pulls Jane from a date to chase strange readings.

their_evidence: Darcy interrupts Jane's date with Richard about signals and drives her to the abandoned factory; the scientists use Selvig's devices at Greenwich.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Erik Selvig is Jane Foster's mentor and an old friend of her late father.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Selvig's protégée, whose late father was his old friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jane's mentor, and an old friend of her late father.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Selvig reunites with Jane in London and works out that the Convergence will peak at Greenwich. There his last device sends Malekith's falling ship away from her and Thor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Protégée Selvig saves from Malekith's falling ship at Greenwich.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Mentor whose last device saves Jane from Malekith's falling ship.

their_evidence: Thor and Foster reunite in London with Foster's mentor Selvig, who locates the Convergence at Greenwich; Selvig teleports the Ark away as it nearly crushes Thor and Foster.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Erik Selvig is suspicious of Thor when Jane finds him in the desert, but he helps him get out of S.H.I.E.L.D. custody and the two bond over drinks.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: God Selvig distrusts at first, then helps escape and bonds with over drinks.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Jane's mentor, wary at first, who helps Thor escape S.H.I.E.L.D. They bond over drinks.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Selvig greets Thor in London and helps him find where Malekith will strike. At Greenwich, Selvig's devices let Thor stop Malekith, and his last one saves Thor from the falling Dark Elf ship.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who uses Selvig's devices to stop Malekith.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist whose device saves Thor from Malekith's falling ship.

their_evidence: Selvig greets Thor at the apartment and identifies Greenwich; Thor uses Selvig's Gravimetric Spikes on Malekith; Selvig's device teleports the Ark away from the unconscious Thor.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall is the all seeing guardian of the Bifrost and one of Thor's most loyal friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Prince who counts Heimdall among his most loyal friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian of the Bifrost, and one of Thor's most loyal friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: After hiding Asgard's people from Hela until Thor's return, Heimdall dies at Thanos' hands after sending the Hulk to Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Heimdall's friend and king. Heimdall hides Asgard's people until Thor returns.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's loyal friend. Hides Asgard's people, then dies at Thanos' hands.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Heimdall loses sight of Jane and sends Thor to find her. When Odin will not act, Heimdall agrees to help Thor take Jane off Asgard and confesses his treason to Odin to buy them time.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Friend Heimdall commits treason to help.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who commits treason to help Thor get Jane off Asgard.

their_evidence: Heimdall tells Thor he has lost sight of Jane; in the tavern he reluctantly agrees to Thor's plan and then distracts Odin by confessing treason.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Loki and Sif grow up fighting side by side as Thor's companions, but they never get along. When Loki seizes the throne, Sif defies him and fights his Destroyer on Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Thor's companion Loki never gets along with, who defies his rule.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's brother, a fellow companion Sif never gets along with.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Sif helps free Loki for Thor's escape but holds her sword to his throat and warns that she will kill him if he betrays Thor. Loki only smiles and tells her it is nice to see her too.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Warrior who holds a sword to Loki's throat as a warning.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Prisoner Sif warns she will kill if he betrays Thor.

their_evidence: Quote: 'Betray him, and I will kill you.' / 'Nice to see you, too, Sif.' Sif holds her sword to Loki's throat during the escape.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: The Warriors Three suspect Loki of treachery when he takes the throne, and they defy him by going to Earth to bring Thor home. Loki sends the Destroyer after them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Thor's friends, who defy Loki, so he sends the Destroyer after them.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's brother, whom the Warriors Three suspect. Sends the Destroyer after them.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Prisoner the Warriors Three help free, but threaten if he betrays Thor.

their_evidence: Volstagg: 'If you even think about betraying him...' Loki: 'You'll kill me? Evidently, there will be a line.' Fandral: 'I see your time in the dungeon has made you no less graceful, Loki.'

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Sif fights alongside the Warriors Three as Thor's closest companions. Together they join his raid on Jotunheim and travel to Earth to bring him home.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sif's fellow warriors and Thor's closest companions.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow warrior who fights at Thor's side with the Warriors Three.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Sif fights beside Volstagg, Fandral and Hogun against the Marauders on Vanaheim, then joins Volstagg and Fandral in defying Odin to help Thor escape Asgard.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow warrior who fights beside them on Vanaheim.

their_evidence: Sif fights alongside the Warriors Three on Vanaheim; Sif, Fandral and Volstagg help Thor, Jane and Loki escape Asgard.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Sif and Thor are close friends from childhood who fight side by side as warriors of Asgard.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sif's close friend since childhood and fellow warrior of Asgard.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's close friend since childhood and fellow warrior of Asgard.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Sif saves Thor from a missile on Vanaheim and quietly hopes to rekindle his feelings for her. Later she frees Jane from her cell so Thor can take her off Asgard.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Old friend whose life Sif saves on Vanaheim.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Old friend who saves Thor's life and frees Jane for him.

stages.text: The Warriors Three are Thor's closest companions in battle, joining his reckless raid on Jotunheim and later coming to Earth to bring him home.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's closest companions in battle.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: After years at Thor's side, including helping him smuggle Jane and Loki out of Asgard, the Warriors Three are killed by Hela when she seizes the throne.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The Warriors Three's longtime friend. They die at Hela's hands.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's longtime companions, killed by Hela.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: The Warriors Three fight beside Thor on Vanaheim. Volstagg and Fandral then risk treason to help him smuggle Jane and Loki off Asgard, holding off the guards so he can escape.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Friend they risk treason to help escape Asgard.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friends who risk treason to help Thor escape Asgard.

their_evidence: Battle of Vanaheim with Thor; secret meeting; Volstagg holds off the Einherjar at the Harrow and Fandral flies the skiff and fights off pursuers.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Darcy is Jane Foster's assistant, and she tasers Thor the moment he lands on Earth. She is soon amused by the strange visitor as he stays with Jane's team in New Mexico.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Jane's assistant, who tasers Thor the moment he lands on Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The stranger from the sky whom Darcy tasers, then warms to.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Darcy catches up with Thor when he finds Jane in London, asking him how space is. After he returns from Svartalfheim, she greets him and Jane at the apartment and joins the fight at Greenwich.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Jane's friend, who asks Thor how space is.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Friend from New Mexico whom Darcy catches up with in London.

their_evidence: At the factory Darcy catches up with Thor and asks how space was; back at Jane's apartment she greets them before the group plans for Greenwich.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall lets the Warriors Three through the Bifrost when they follow Thor to Jotunheim. When Loki takes the throne, Heimdall calls them before him and lets them go to Earth to bring Thor home, defying Loki's orders.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Thor's companions. Heimdall lets them go to Earth against Loki's orders.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Gatekeeper, who defies Loki to let the Warriors Three bring Thor home.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Heimdall joins Volstagg and Fandral in Thor's secret meeting to get Jane off Asgard, telling them Loki knows the hidden paths, then distracts Odin while they carry out the escape.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow plotters in Thor's escape from Asgard.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Gatekeeper who plots with them to get Jane off Asgard.

their_evidence: Secret meeting of Thor, Heimdall, Sif, Fandral and Volstagg; Heimdall explains other ways off Asgard known to Loki and later distracts Odin.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: When Loki takes the throne, Heimdall lets Sif and the Warriors Three use the Bifrost to bring Thor home, defying Loki's orders. After Loki strikes him down, Sif and the others carry the wounded Heimdall to be healed.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian warrior Heimdall lets pass to bring Thor home.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Asgard's gatekeeper, who lets Sif pass to bring Thor home.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Heimdall and Sif join Thor's secret plan to get Jane off Asgard. Sif frees Jane while Heimdall distracts Odin by confessing treason.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Warrior who frees Jane while Heimdall distracts Odin.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Gatekeeper who distracts Odin while Sif frees Jane.

their_evidence: Both attend Thor's secret meeting; Sif frees Foster from her guards; Heimdall summons Odin to Himinbjorg and confesses treason.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Odin is the king the Warriors Three serve. He rescues them and Thor from the Frost Giants on Jotunheim, then has the wounded Fandral taken to be healed.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Odin's warriors, whom he rescues from the Frost Giants on Jotunheim.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Warriors Three's king, who rescues them from the Frost Giants on Jotunheim.

proposed.title: Thor: The Dark World
proposed.text: Fandral warns Odin that the palace shields are still down after the Dark Elves' attack. Soon after, Fandral and Volstagg defy Odin's orders to help Thor take Jane off Asgard.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Warriors who defy Odin's orders to help Thor.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: King whose orders they defy to help Thor take Jane off Asgard.

their_evidence: Fandral to Odin: 'We are still unable to restore the palace shields... My king, we are all but defenseless.' They then help Thor's escape against Odin's order that none leave Asgard.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Xavier takes Logan into his school after the X-Men save him and Rogue, and offers to help him uncover his lost past. Logan stays and fights for him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Takes Logan in and offers to help him find his past.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A drifter Xavier takes into his school and turns into an X-Man.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In a future where Sentinels hunt mutants, Xavier asks Logan to travel back to 1973 and guide his younger self. When history changes, Logan wakes to find Xavier alive and his school thriving.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sends Logan back to 1973 to save the future.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The X-Man Xavier sends back in time to change history.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: Logan clashes with Xavier over the blocks Xavier placed in Jean's mind, then follows him into her childhood home, where Jean destroys him before Logan's eyes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clashes with Logan over Jean's mind, and dies in front of him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Challenges Xavier over Jean, then watches him die.

their_evidence: In the infirmary Logan angrily confronts Xavier for caging Jean's mind; at the Grey house Logan, pinned to the ceiling, watches Jean disintegrate Xavier.

stages.title: X2
stages.text: During Stryker's raid, Bobby leads Logan, Rogue, and John to his parents' house in Boston, where he tells his family he is a mutant.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Leads Logan to Bobby's parents' house after the raid.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Shepherds Bobby and his friends after the raid.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: When Bobby reminds Logan there are only six of them left, Logan rallies him to fight Magneto at Alcatraz. There Logan asks Bobby to take down Pyro, and Bobby goes after him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Answers Logan's call to fight, and takes on Pyro for him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Rallies Bobby to fight and sends him after Pyro.

their_evidence: In the mansion tunnels Bobby says there are only six of them, Logan gives his speech and Bobby says they're in; at Alcatraz Logan asks Bobby if he can take down his old friend Pyro.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Kitty uses her power to send Logan's mind back to 1973 and holds it there, bleeding and exhausted, until history changes.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Sends Logan's mind back to 1973 and holds it there.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Kitty sends his mind back to 1973 and holds it there.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: Logan runs Kitty's Danger Room session, then rallies her and the other young X-Men to stand with him against Magneto at Alcatraz.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: One of the last X-Men who follow Logan to Alcatraz.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Rallies Kitty to fight at Alcatraz.

their_evidence: Logan subs for Scott in the Danger Room with Kitty among the team; later he tells Bobby, Kitty and Peter they are outnumbered but must fight, and they sign they're ready before flying to Alcatraz.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Xavier's voice guides the blinded teenage Scott and the other children freed from Stryker's island to safety, and he welcomes them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The boy Xavier leads to safety and raises at his school.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rescues Scott and raises him as an X-Man.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: While Scott grieves for Jean, Xavier worries he is a changed man. When Scott meets Jean at Alkali Lake, Xavier senses his distress and sends Logan and Storm after him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The grieving student whose distress Xavier senses at Alkali Lake.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Senses Scott's distress and sends help.

their_evidence: Xavier tells Storm that Scott is a changed man after Jean's death and asks Logan to cover for him; later Xavier senses Scott's distress telepathically (Scott's name echoes through the school) and sends Logan and Storm to Alkali Lake.

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Xavier takes in Rogue after her power puts a boy in a coma, and the X-Men save her from Magneto's machine.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The runaway Xavier takes in.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Gives Rogue a home.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: When Rogue bursts in to ask whether mutants can really be cured, Xavier admits it appears to be true.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A student who asks Xavier if the cure is real.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Admits to Rogue the cure seems real.

their_evidence: After Hank's news, Rogue walks in and asks if it is true they can cure them; Xavier admits it appears to be true before Storm insists there is nothing to cure.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Kitty, once a student at his school, sends Logan's mind back to 1973 while Xavier guides the plan.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's former student, who sends Logan back.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Guides the plan Kitty carries out.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: In Xavier's ethics class, Kitty answers him by quoting Einstein on ethics, and Xavier jokes that Einstein wasn't a mutant, as far as they know.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A student who quotes Einstein in Xavier's ethics class.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Teaches Kitty's ethics class.

their_evidence: During Xavier's lesson on the misuse of power, Kitty remarks that Einstein said ethics are an exclusively human concern; Xavier replies that Einstein wasn't a mutant, as far as they know.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 2023, Colossus guards Kitty while she sends minds back through time, and he dies holding off the Sentinels.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Guards Kitty and dies for the plan.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Sends minds back in time while Colossus guards her.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
proposed.text: Kitty and Peter train together in the Danger Room and are two of the last three students who sign on when Logan rallies the X-Men to fight at Alcatraz.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow young X-Man beside Kitty at Alcatraz.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow young X-Man beside Peter at Alcatraz.

their_evidence: Both are in the Danger Room session; in the mansion tunnels Bobby looks at Kitty and Peter, they both signal they're ready, and the six X-Men fly to Alcatraz and hold the line together.
